findings.finding: The package contains no hosted Bucket-01 workflow. Exact-head execution and retained reports must be supplied separately without changing the technical benchmark definitions.

The annular T6 generator is evaluated independently for mapped area, radius, centre, ligament, perimeter, boundary deviation, midside placement, rotational symmetry, dense Jacobians, connectivity, shared edges, duplicates and feature sets.
Material, load and restraint coverage must remain separate from pure mesh geometry qualification.
The retained T6 patch covers distorted geometry, rigid motions, scaling, rotation and Jacobian rejection.

A frozen closed-form affine uniaxial-stress oracle and governed T3 receipt cover plane stress and plane strain, exact nodal displacement, constant element strain and stress, load-path parity, energy, equilibrium and deterministic replay.

A frozen closed-form pure-shear oracle and governed T3 receipt cover exact affine displacement, shear strain, tensor and derived stress, energy, load-path parity, equilibrium and deterministic replay.
A frozen plane-stress pure-bending oracle and T6 benchmark cover quadratic displacement, linear integration-point stress, energy, resultant and moment equilibrium.

The 64/256/1024 ladder has a frozen load and moment oracle, force and moment equilibrium evaluation, independent half-external-work reconstruction, strain-energy GCI, a production runner and retained-result receipt.

The production continuum route preserves dense Cholesky below 1536 DOFs and uses deterministic full-symmetric CSR assembly with Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate gradients above that threshold. Exact 1024-element lug execution has not yet been retained.
Fixed element-local probes reconstruct tensor components from retained T6 integration points with no nodal projection or cross-element averaging.
Evaluators provide observed order, Richardson extrapolation, GCI, asymptotic checks, oracle-bound invariant resultants and oscillatory/non-monotonic blocking.

A frozen classical Kirsch oracle defines three off-boundary physical probe coordinates. A governed T6 quarter-annulus receipt integrates exact Kirsch outer traction to quadratic boundary nodes, reconstructs unrounded tensor stress from retained T6 integration points, evaluates principal stress against the oracle, and applies three-level GCI without moving maxima, nodal projection or cross-element averaging.
The governed Kirsch fixed-coordinate route is implemented. Production lug fixed-coordinate probe and path evidence remains ungenerated.
No governing code, edition, allowable source, classification or independent code oracle is frozen.
The final exact candidate requires three clean deterministic executions with retained report-data hashes.
